title_original: Цифровой Кодекс Кыргызской Республики
title_en: Digital Code of the Kyrgyz Republic
ai_digital_provisions: COMPREHENSIVE DIGITAL CODE — MOST SIGNIFICANT LEGISLATION IN KG DIGITAL HISTORY. Entry into force: February 6, 2026 (6 months after publication August 8, 2025). Structure: Part I General Provisions (Chapters 1-9): digital environment foundations, state regulation, digital identification, rights protection. Part II Special Provisions — Section III Data Processing: personal data (Chapter 11, 100+ definitions), spatial data, digital registries. Section IV Digital Services: wellness, telecom, trusted services, government services, national ecosystem. Section V Digital Technology Systems: AI systems regulation (Chapter 23, high-risk AI requires danger assessment + compliance confirmation), telecommunications networks. KEY AI PROVISION: High-risk AI systems require danger assessment and compliance confirmation. Establishes sectoral regulators for personal data and telecom. Secondary legislation (bylaws implementing the code) being drafted throughout 2026 — LEVERAGE WINDOW for AI auditability standards, model registries, testing requirements (CW-010).

title_original: О неотложных мерах по эффективной реализации цифровой трансформации (ликвидация Министерства цифрового развития, передача функций Управлению делами Президента)
title_en: On Urgent Measures for Effective Implementation of Digital Transformation (Liquidation of Ministry of Digital Development, Transfer of Functions to Presidential Administration)
ai_digital_provisions: MOST CONSEQUENTIAL KG DIGITAL GOVERNANCE EVENT IN 24 MONTHS. Liquidates Ministry of Digital Development and Innovative Technologies. Transfers ALL functions to УДП (Управление делами Президента): digital policy, state digital services, telecom regulation, cybersecurity, archives, satellite technology, AI, innovation. Creates within УДП: (1) Департамент цифровизации и инновационных технологий; (2) Департамент по регулированию связи; (3) Фонд развития цифровой инфраструктуры. Timeline: 1 week — asset transfer commission; 1 month — new structural regulations + Cabinet amendments to Digital Code; 2 months — all Cabinet decisions aligned. Deputy positions for digital development eliminated across state agencies (except МВД). Every existing donor program counterpart is now uncertain.

ai_digital_provisions: February 2025 amendments to existing presidential decrees. Context: Ministry of Digital Development renamed to Ministry of Digital Development and Innovative Technologies in early 2025, and new minister Жамангулов appointed. This decree may formalize that restructuring.

sources.title: Указ Президента КР от 28 февраля 2025 года УП № 71 «О внесении изменений в некоторые указы Президента Кыргызской Республики»

title_original: Положение об Управлении делами президента Кыргызской Республики (новая структура после апреля 2026 года)
title_en: Regulations on the Presidential Administration of the Kyrgyz Republic (New Structure Post-April 2026)
ai_digital_provisions: CRITICAL PENDING DOCUMENT. Within one month of the April 30, 2026 liquidation decree, the Cabinet must produce new structural regulations for the UDP digital departments. This document will define: (1) mandate of Департамент цифровизации и инновационных технологий; (2) mandate of Департамент по регулированию связи; (3) governance of Фонд развития цифровой инфраструктуры; (4) authority over Tunduk/Infocom. Every B2G vendor in KG needs to know this document.

sources.title: Требование разработать положение об УДП в течение месяца — зафиксировано в указе от 30.04.2026

title_original: О передаче Государственного предприятия «Тундук» в ведение ГП «Инфоком» и Управления делами Президента
title_en: On Transfer of State Enterprise 'Tunduk' to GP Infocom and Presidential Administration
ai_digital_provisions: Formal transfer of Tunduk to Infocom under UDP authority following April 2026 decree. This document crystallizes the new institutional ownership of KG's inter-agency data exchange (SMEV equivalent). Critical for understanding who to pitch for Tunduk modernization (CW-008).

sources.title: Тундук перешла в Инфоком — информация из 24.kg по итогам апрельской реорганизации 2026
